transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! How are you feeling today after your cataract surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: How are your eyes doing since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: So, your overall eye recovery is going well. Have you noticed any redness in your eyes since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, there's no redness in my eyes. My recovery has been smooth.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's great to hear. Is your eye currently painful?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, there's no eye pain. My eye is feeling fine overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: So, your recovery is going smoothly. Has your vision improved as you expected since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, my recovery has been smooth, and my vision is fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any floaters since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any floaters. My eye is feeling fine overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: So, you haven't noticed any floaters. Have you noticed any flashing lights since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any flashing lights. My recovery has been smooth, and my eye is feeling fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's great to hear. You've been having a smooth recovery. Let me summarize what you've told me so far: your overall eye recovery is going well, you haven't experienced any redness or pain, your vision has improved, and you haven't noticed any floaters or flashing lights. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct. My recovery has been smooth. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It sounds like you're having a great recovery. I've made a note of everything we've discussed. Thank you for sharing this information with me.

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent explicitly asked the top-level question for eye redness: "Have you noticed any redness in your eyes since the surgery?" and the patient answered it.
